purpose: Predeclare classifier and policy before receiving independent reviewer judgments.
selection_basis: Existing development comparison; lower modeled urgency cost with explicit review workload.

review_protocol.context: fresh context; parent history not forked
review_protocol.unknown_labels: preserve unclear category and urgency; do not force guesses

metrics: Existing evaluate.py definitions, including known-label denominators, all missed urgent flags incurring delay cost, both 30 and 100 penalty matrices, review coverage and warm inference timing.
implementation_policy: Do not change engine.py, taxonomy.py or tune model parameters based on independent labels. Importer/evaluator updates only add truthful agent provenance and leave scoring definitions unchanged.
limits: Separate agent, same model family and shared written rubric; not domain-expert or human validation.
